meta.title: Line-Item Quantity Split: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and as a Buyer in the same tenant
Observe or perform the Line-Item Quantity Split action on a PR line item
Compare whether the split action is refused or absent for the non-Buyer and available for the Buyer
Verify the tenant's Growth plan and RBAC configuration for this permission
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and as a Buyer in the same tenant; Observe or perform the Line-Item Quantity Split action on a PR line item; Compare whether the split action is refused or absent for the non-Buyer and available for the Buyer; Verify the tenant's Growth plan and RBAC configuration for this permission

steps.note: Reach the Purchase Requisitions flow where the pre-event line-item action would be tested.
Use open purchase requests, which can be selected for event preparation.
Select a purchase request so its line items become available.
Open the selected PR's purchase items and start the event preparation flow.

args.need: sign in as the non-Buyer user and then as the Buyer in the same tenant, attempt Line-Item Quantity Split on a PR line item capped at the PR quantity, and report whether the action is refused or absent for the non-Buyer and available for the Buyer

steps.note: Role-specific sessions and the Line-Item Quantity Split control/action are not expressible by catalog steps.
Assert that the session remains usable after the tester completes or reports the manual role comparison.
